concerns.text: Task T022 is marked as [ ] (unimplemented) but is a critical dependency for T024, T025, T037, T039, and T041. The spec FR-008 (dataset size < 50 rows check) and the creation of 'validated_clipped.csv' are not covered by any other task. Without T022, the data flow for US2 and US3 is broken.

Task T023 (generate ingestion_metrics.json) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This task is required to satisfy SC-007 (completeness of ingestion pipeline metrics). No other task generates 'ingestion_metrics.json' or aggregates the required metrics (rows_ingested, rows_dropped_nulls, etc.).

Task T024 (interaction feature engineering) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This is the core implementation of FR-002 (engineer interaction features). Without this, US1 cannot produce the 'EngineeredFeatureSet' required for US2 and US3.

Task T025 (generate final_dataset.csv) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This task is required to produce the final input artifact for US2 (T028/T029) and US3 (T037). No other task produces 'data/processed/final_dataset.csv'.
Task T029 (Random Forest training) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This is the core implementation of FR-003 and FR-004. Without this, US2 cannot produce the 'kinetic_model.pkl' required for US3.

Task T037 (Baseline Model training) is marked [~] (ambiguous status, likely unimplemented). This task is required for FR-005 (Permutation Test comparing Additive vs Interaction models). Without it, the statistical significance test cannot be performed.

Task T041 (SHAP Interaction Value analysis) is marked [~] (ambiguous status). This task is required for FR-006 (feature importance rankings via Shapley values). Without it, US3 cannot identify key drivers.

Task T045 (Update README.md) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The plan.md and spec.md imply a need for documentation, and SC-008 requires the generation of reports, but the specific task to update the README with the 5-step execution guide is missing implementation status.
Task T046 (Update quickstart.md) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). Similar to T045, the quickstart guide is a required artifact per plan.md, but the task to update it is not marked as complete.

Task T048 (Refactor ingest.py for error handling) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This task addresses the 'No Fabrication' rule and FR-001 (primary source handling). Without it, the system may not correctly handle external data fetch failures as specified.

Task T050 (Implement chunked data loading) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This task is required to satisfy FR-003 (memory usage < 4GB) for datasets > 5MB. Without it, the system may crash on larger inputs.

Task T052 (Write unit tests for engineer.py) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). While tests are optional per the header, the spec US1 Independent Test requires verifying interaction feature engineering. Without T052, this specific verification is missing.

Task T055 (Implement external data fetching) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This task is required to satisfy FR-001 (secondary source ingestion). Without it, the system cannot attempt to fetch from NIST/HuggingFace as specified.

Task T059 (Verify T024 feature engineering) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This is a review task to ensure FR-002 compliance. Without it, there is no explicit task to verify the feature engineering logic.
Task T062 (Verify T013 main.py implementation) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This is a review task to ensure the pipeline orchestrator is correct. Without it, the data flow verification is missing.
Task T063 (Verify T022 fail-loud logic) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This is a review task to ensure the 'Fail-Loud' principle is met. Without it, the data integrity check is missing.
Task T064 (Verify T021 outlier clipping timing) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This is a review task to ensure FR-007 compliance. Without it, the outlier clipping verification is missing.

Task T069 (Implement fail-loud logic in generate_synthetic.py) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This task is required to ensure the 'No Fabrication' rule is upheld. Without it, the synthetic generator may not fail correctly.
Task T070 (Update main.py to enforce data flow) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This task is required to ensure the correct data lineage. Without it, the data flow verification is missing.
Task T072 (Implement fail-fast check in ingest.py) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This task is required to satisfy FR-008 (dataset size < 50 rows). Without it, the fail-fast check is missing.

Task T073 (Implement fallback logic in ingest_external.py) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This task is required to ensure the correct fallback behavior for external data. Without it, the fallback logic is missing.
Task T074 (Verify data flow for T023 metrics) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This is a review task to ensure T023 metrics are correct. Without it, the metrics verification is missing.
Task T075 (Verify T029 Pure Aluminum handling for SHAP) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This is a review task to ensure the edge case is handled. Without it, the edge case verification is missing.
Task T076 (Verify T039 Delta-Permutation Test logic) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). This is a review task to ensure the permutation test is correct. Without it, the test verification is missing.
